status_note: Second V3 iteration. Test of the total-training-steps hypothesis from iter 1: corpus held at n=100 (same source corpus, iter-1 generation) but epochs cut 3->2 (NUM_EPOCHS=2, commit 6b7248e), with the fuzzy-support gate enabled via deterministic recovery (src/09_recover_fuzzy.py). Positive result -- field F1 recovered from iter 1's 0.6581 to 0.6745 and missing_field's share of failures dropped to 52.3%, the lowest measured in V3; the 288-record eval corroborates (F1 0.6742). Still below the published V2/iter-15 checkpoint (0.6827) on the 72-record eval, so not a HF-upload candidate -- see logs/V3_TRAINING_FAILURES.md V3 Iteration 2.

provenance.note: Teacher generation for iter 2 wedged (deadlock at batch 208/900, busy-spin >1h, killed). Because generation is deterministic (greedy, temp=0.0), iter-1 saved raw outputs are byte-identical to a fresh run; the gate was re-run on the saved rejections (data/teacher_dataset_rejections_v3iter1_bak.json) with fuzzy_support=True on CPU, recovering 534/1443 (37%) step-3 rejections and merging to 2691/3600 admitted. See commit body for the wedge incident and src/09_recover_fuzzy.py for the recovery script.
provenance.orchestrator: manual (src/09_recover_fuzzy.py for dataset recovery, src/02_train_distill.py, src/08_hybrid_eval.py, src/07_failure_eval.py via SSH + nohup)
provenance.checkpoint_backup_performed_manually: models/distilled_minicpm5_1b_v2_amd_pre_v3iter2 (verified intact on amd-training-2 before this run started)

dataset.source: data/corpus_v3_iter1.jsonl (same 3600-record corpus as iter 1; generation itself not re-run due to the wedge)

recovery.rejections_source: data/teacher_dataset_rejections_v3iter1_bak.json (1443 records, backup of iter-1 rejections made 2026-08-11T02:00Z)
recovery.note: 534/1443 iter-1 step-3 rejections re-admitted under fuzzy_support=True (threshold 0.85); 2691 = 2157 (iter-1 admitted) + 534.

training_configuration.changes_from_iteration_15: epochs 3 -> 2 (NUM_EPOCHS named constant, commit 6b7248e) AND training corpus now the fuzzy-gate version (2691 admitted vs 1625 at iter 15); same seed (42), LR (2e-5), batch_size 2, AdamW, cosine schedule, bf16.
training_configuration.total_training_steps_comparison: 2692 (1346 steps/epoch x 2) vs. iter 1's 3237 (1079 x 3) and iteration 15's 2439 (813 x 3). Stopping one epoch earlier under the larger corpus lands total steps between the two prior runs -- isolating 'total steps' from 'corpus size' for the first time.

per_epoch_loss.note: epoch-1 avg loss 0.0486, epoch-2 avg loss 0.0162 (means over 1346 logged steps/epoch, from logs/02_train_distill_v3iter2.log). Near-zero-loss by end of epoch 2 as in every prior run.

training_performance.checkpoint_sha256_note: sha256 of models/distilled_minicpm5_1b_v2_amd/model.safetensors computed on amd-training-2 after training completed

evaluation_metrics_72record_eval.comparison_to_iteration_15: field F1 0.6827 -> 0.6581 (iter 1) -> 0.6745 (this run, +0.0164 over iter 1): cutting epochs from 3 to 2 under the larger fuzzy-gate corpus recovered most of the ground iter 1 lost, supporting the total-training-steps mechanism. missing_field share dropped to 52.3% (196/375), the lowest measured in V3. Still -0.0082 below iteration 15's 0.6827 on this eval set.

evaluation_metrics_288record_eval.note: Larger eval set corroborates the 72-record result: field F1 0.6742, schema validity 0.8715, missing_field_rate 0.1207.

final_artifacts.checkpoint_used_for_huggingface_upload_n: field F1 (0.6745 on the 72-record eval) remains below the published V2/iter-15 checkpoint (0.6827), though the 288-record eval (0.6742) has no direct iter-15 comparison. Not a candidate for HF upload; missing_field remains the dominant failure class.
